👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

How do you sell fragrance online and still build a ₹200+ crore brand?
In this episode of the Indian Business Podcast, I sat down with Adil Qadri, Founder & Owner of Adil Qadri Perfumes, to understand the real business behind perfumes.

From starting with online experiments to building a brand with 40+ stores, Adil breaks down:
- How perfumes are actually made 
- Why most fragrance brands fail to find product-market fit
- The truth about premium pricing, packaging psychology, and compliments
- Amazon vs Shopify for Indian D2C founders
- Why Cash On Delivery, is painful but still unavoidable in India
- Lessons from Shark Tank and working with Vineeta Singh

If you’re a founder, operator, or brand builder, this episode will change how you look at consumer businesses.

Watch the full episode on the Indian Business Podcast.
